shots.focal_element: Recreated classic search results page: pill search bar with a query above a grid of white product cards with headphone photos and grey placeholder text bars
on_screen_text: What are the best headphones in 2025?
shots.typography: Clean geometric sans; query in light grey regular weight sentence case as placeholder-style text; 'Search' in white medium weight inside a black pill button; normal tracking
shots.what_happens: A 5-frame opening frame of the same search-results layout seen in s002, positioned slightly higher in frame; no visible change within the shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a centered stack of rounded white cards (search bar pill plus 2-1-2 grid of product cards with image and grey skeleton bars) with soft drop shadows over a dark navy radial-vignette background, starting about 50px above its resting position.

shots.focal_element: The traditional search results card grid under the 'best headphones in 2025' query
shots.transition_other: continuous drift: the layout appears shifted down relative to s001 (likely a slow vertical move rather than a cut)
on_screen_text: What are the best headphones in 2025?
shots.typography: Geometric sans throughout; query placeholder in light grey regular sentence case; black pill 'Search' button with white medium label; final frame shows a white medium-weight headline 'What can I help with?' above a chat-style input with small grey pill chips
shots.what_happens: The results grid holds and slowly settles (slight scale/position change across the 0.5s samples) while the VO says 'AI search is here,' (w0-w3); by the 2.0s sample the scene has switched to an AI chat prompt with the query starting to type in ('What are th'). The exact switch mechanism is not visible at 2 fps.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the card grid with a gentle 1-2% scale-down drift for ~1.8s, then replace it with a centered AI chat input whose query types on character by character.

shots.focal_element: AI assistant prompt box with the typed query 'What are the best headphones in 2025?'
on_screen_text: What are the best headphones in 2025?
shots.typography: White medium-weight sans headline in sentence case centered above the input; query in grey regular sentence case; small grey outlined pill chips with icons ('Attach', 'Search', 'Reason'); black pill 'Search' button with white label
shots.what_happens: Generic AI chat interface: the query finishes typing ('...in 2') and completes by 3.0s, then holds while the VO says 'reshaping everything, ready to see where you stand' (w4-w11).
shots.build_rebuild: Center a white rounded input card with a white headline above it on the navy vignette, type the query in at roughly 15-20 characters per second, then hold for about 1.4s.

shots.focal_element: AI answer panel with three product cards beside an 'AI Market Share' donut chart showing 'Your brand' vs four competitors
shots.transition_other: slide-in/expand: the answer card enters from the left while a narrow side panel slides in from the right, then both settle into the split layout
on_screen_text: What are the best headphones in 2025?
What are the best headphones in 2025?
shots.typography: Same geometric sans; query echoed in a small grey pill chip in medium weight; 'AI Market Share' as a medium-weight title in a grey pill; legend labels regular weight sentence case with coloured dot bullets
shots.what_happens: The search box expands into an AI answer card containing a query chip, skeleton text lines and three product cards; simultaneously an 'AI Market Share' side panel slides in, its donut chart draws on and its legend labels fade in (visible mid-reveal at 5.0s: 'AI Mar', partial legend). shots.build_rebuild: Expand the input card into a taller answer card with staggered product thumbnails, slide a side panel in from the right, draw a five-segment donut clockwise over ~0.5s and stagger the five legend rows in, then apply a slow horizontal drift.

shots.composition_other: scattered cloud of floating pills and circular badges across the full frame

shots.transition_other: pop/fade-in of the logo cloud (anchors list a swoosh_reverse SFX at ~7.51s, x003); entry frames not visible at 2 fps

shots.build_rebuild: Scatter ~11 white pill and circle logo badges with soft shadows across the frame and animate each with a slow, randomised 5-10px float loop so the field feels alive but crowded.
